senses: to be good, be pleasing, be joyful, be beneficial, be pleasant, be favourable, be happy, be right
to be well with, be good for
(Hiphil) to do well, do good, act right, act rightly

strongs.def: to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense
strongs.kjv: be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make) goodly, [idiom] please, (be, do, go, play) well
